messages:
Alex M: Heads-up — we saw a downstream regression in Marketplace images when the infra pair updated to driver 535 + CUDA 12.3. Images that rely on pinned cuDNN ops are failing startup in some regions. 
Marta T: ack. which partners are affected? marketplace images only or OEM stacks too?
Alex M: so far Marketplace (aws eu-west-1, gcp us-central) and one SI reference infra image. Not the full OEM fleets yet, but distro tests are flaky.
Dominik R: @Alex M can you paste the failing logs? would help to check symbol mismatches.
Alex M: here, truncated: ```
E tensorflow/stream_executor/cuda/cuda_driver.cc:1234] failed to load cuDNN: unresolved symbol cudnnGetConvolutionForwardAlgorithm
E failed init: cuda driver: incompatible cuDNN version
```
Sai P: hmm likely a cuDNN ABI change in the driver bundle. We need to propose a pin/compat plan for partners.
Marta T: propose steps: 1) immediate rollback pin for Marketplace AMIs 2) emergency compat shim for SI customers 3) partner notification + coordinated hotfix window.
Ellen S: +1. Add a canary rollout schedule so we don't hit more regions. Suggest canary in us-central-1 first.
Alex M: plan draft: - pin driver to 534.x for all marketplace images built in last 72h - hold new images behind gated release lane - schedule partner call for 18:00 UTC today to align on hotfix and messaging - enable extra tests in CI for cuDNN symbol checks.
Dominik R: for the gated release lane, do we have an automation to block images that reference driver >=535? We can add a policy in the image builder.
Sai P: yes, we can add this policy quickly. Example gate rule for image-builder: ```yaml
policy:
  deny_if:
    - driver_version: ">=535"
    - checks: [cuDNN_unresolved_symbols]
```
Marta T: notify partners: draft message? I can draft and send from Partnerships. Need to clarify impact and mitigation steps.
Alex M: @Marta T please include recommended rollback (534.x) + canary window + contact for urgent SI help. Also flag that we plan a hotfix driver build (535.1) with backwards cuDNN symbols — ETA 24h.
Ellen S: Can we get a patch build earlier? Ops: how long to validate a 535.1 quickbuild?
Dominik R: building and smoke-testing a driver shim + patched cuDNN likely ~6-8 hours, but full QA for marketplace images ~12-18h. We can expedite with canaries.
Deploy-Bot: Deployment window scheduled: marketplace-image-hold enabled at 2067890200. Canary rollout job queued for us-central-1.
Sai P: I'll open a partner-facing doc and paste here: https://internal.redwood/partnerships/driver-535-compat (draft).
Marta T: leaving message to partners: "We detected startup failures for Marketplace images tied to driver 535 / CUDA 12.3. Immediate mitigation: we are pinning builds to 534.x while we push a compatibility hotfix. Please avoid new deployments to affected images. We will host a sync call at 18:00 UTC; join for details." :email:

Alex M: @everyone please react with :thumbsup: if you can join the 18:00 UTC call. Need engineers from SI teams (esp. @Dominik R) and partner PD.
Dominik R: +1
Sai P: +1
Ellen S: +1
Marta T: sending calendar invite now — adding link to draft doc and CI gating steps.
Alex M: thanks. After call, we'll produce a short technical advisory and an internal playbook for Marketplace engineering to avoid recurrence (automated symbol checks + pre-release canary).
Ellen S: suggest adding automated alert in Console to flag failed symbol loads per-region so we detect faster next time.
Alex M: good call. I'll file infra ticket and tag eng-infra + eng-runtime for the alert. ticket: https://redwood.issues/RI-4021
Marta T: partner call notes will be posted to the doc. If anyone cannot make 18:00 UTC, DM me and we'll follow up. :phone:
